format: RL10's conversation between sminos and the mawsd endpoint (MAWS docs/doperpowers/plans/2026-10-27-p5-o10-endpoint.md, M6 and Interfaces §D), replayed by both sides: the endpoint's suite (test/endpoint/rl10/conversation.local.test.ts) plays sminos's lines against the real server, and sminos's conformance replay (O12 phase 2, rl10_conformance.py) plays the endpoint's lines against sminos.
Cases run in order on one machine, each building on the last. A step is one of:
{up: frame}            a line sminos sends (the endpoint's suite sends it; sminos's replay checks sminos sent it);
{down: frame}          a line the endpoint sends (the endpoint's suite checks it arrived; sminos's replay sends it);
{open: conn} / {closed: conn}   a connection to the socket opened, or closed by the endpoint with nothing written on it;
{quiet: [t...], ms}    no line of these kinds comes down within ms (the endpoint refused, held, or sent nothing);
{scene: name, ...}     what happens on the endpoint's side (the hub, a device, the org state, a restart); sminos's replay skips it.

conn names the connection a step is on ('main' when absent). Frames are matched whole: {{name}} is a binding, in an object's key as in a value (the header's 'bindings' give sample values, each side substitutes its own run's), and each path in a step's 'vary' (dot-separated, array indexes as numbers) holds a value neither side can predict (a signature, a time, a version), compared only for presence. A down step matches the first line of its kind not matched before it, in order; lines of other kinds may come between. Every audience line the endpoint sends is listed where it comes: the endpoint's suite fails on one no down step matched. digest:X is audienceDigest of members X; members:AB is A and B sorted, as the endpoint sends them.
note: what the step proves, or what sminos's side does with it.
